**sdd/issue-244-a4/tasks**

**What**: Wrote openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/tasks.md — 8-phase strict-TDD checklist for GitLab substrate ladder awareness (A4, #244): (1) gitlab.mjs projectMergeSettings read, (2) substrate.mjs 3 sub-gate evaluators + OR-compose replacing :98-100 short-circuit, (3) behavior-preservation proof (existing no-provider rung-1 tests stay byte-identical), (4) brain-governance-status.mjs provider-dispatched probe + verifiable-driven caveat rendering (removes static line 191), (5) 4 offline governance-status fixture cases, (6) CP-A4a bare-repo append-rejection e2e (new appendAndPush helper), (7) docs/inbox/self-hosted-pre-receive.md extension, (8) baseline (npm test/repo:check/nav/audit) + CP-A4a PR assembly.
**Why**: sdd-tasks phase for issue-244-a4, spec.md (REQ-A4-1..5) + design.md read from openspec files, constraints read from engram #565 (owner ruling — per-branch protected-branch read endorsed over capabilities(), locked field shape, behavior-preservation load-bearing).
**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/tasks.md (new). Confirmed Review Workload Forecast: ~145 non-test counted lines, single PR into feature/v2.0.0, no size:exception, no chain.
**Learned**: Found a genuine spec/design disagreement NOT resolvable from the artifacts — spec.md REQ-A4-2 mandates preReceive's `mechanism:'pre-receive-config-declared'`, but design.md's locked field shape + code snippet use `mechanism: 'config-declared; verify via install runbook'` and calls it "ruling-mandated verbatim" without the ruling itself (memory #565) quoting either string. Flagged as an explicit Open Question in tasks.md (Phase 2.5/4.5), defaulting to spec.md's REQ-A4-2 string as the normative/testable one unless the owner confirms otherwise at apply/review — did NOT silently pick one and did NOT invent a resolution.
